findings.value: A Shoreditch bar, nightclub and rooftop on Curtain Road, open since 2009. It runs club nights, pop and hip hop nights, drag cabaret and a drag bottomless brunch; Time Out calls it a pub, club and everything in-between.

evidence.quote: Welcome to Queen of Hoxton, a vibrant nightclub and bar in Shoreditch that first opened its doors in 2009.
The Queen of Hoxton – pub, club and everything in-between

findings.value: The venue describes itself as a safe, inclusive space for all, with vibrant drag shows.

evidence.quote: our venue honours her legacy with vibrant drag shows and a safe, inclusive space for all
with DJs playing on a cutting-edge disco/house tip on the weekends

findings.value: A mix of club nights, drag cabaret and hip-hop and pop evenings, plus karaoke and weekend DJs playing disco and house, according to Time Out.
